trial_court: Family Court Nalagarh, Case No. HMA No.160 of 2023
case_name: Neelam v. Ravinder Kumar — full case name
facts_of_case: Marriage solemnized on 07.03.2019; petitioner subjected to physical and emotional abuse by respondent; parties made efforts for amicable resolution but failed; petitioner filed petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act and maintenance under Section 125 of Code of Criminal Procedure, which are pending before Family Court Shimla.

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife is to be preferred over the convenience of the husband.
legal_principles.held: In this type of matter, the convenience of the wife is to be preferred over the convenience of the husband.
cited_cases: Rajani Kishor Pardeshi Versus Kishor Babulal Pardeshi (2005) 12 SCC 237

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya versus A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha (2022)

outcome.final_order: Petitioner's petition for restitution of conjugal rights titled as 'Ravinder Kumar Vs. Neelam' Registration No.160/2023, filing Date 25.11.2023 may very kindly be transferred from Ld. Family Court Nalagarh to ld. Family Court Shimla.
